    Camera and accuracy

    How the sizes were worked out

      What is estimated rather than measured

      • The drawer pedestal's depth under the table (only its front face is visible); set to 45 cm.
      • The back half of the backpack and the cloth, which are soft and partly hidden; they are shown as smooth shapes.
      • The steel bottle's base, which sits behind the laptop lid; its position was cross-checked with a second photo of the same desk.
      • The lying plastic bottle and snack packet, which are mostly covered by other objects.
